text:
ava: heads-up: during the late-night canary we accidentally sent full alert fanout. looks like the consoleaction didn't apply the suppression policy.

ellis: saw the spike in notify_fanout_count for tenant=widgetco (~95). stack traces show suppression tag was missing.

simone: is this the new 'preview-only' soft-suppress flow? expected route to preview contacts and lower weight, not full fanout.

raj: short diagnosis: console wrote suppression as a one-shot action but the deploy event had different metadata key, so the runtime transform never matched. race between policy apply and event routing.

tina: proposal: add a console quick-action called 'suppress-rollback' with simulate option that returns estimated fanout & cost delta before applying. on-press shows an estimation modal.

ellis: +1 for simulate. also need the API to return contact coverage change so oncall sees who will be skipped.

simone: implementation debate: runtime transform inside notify-service (closest to fanout) vs precomputed policy written by console. i vote for transform to avoid key mismatch.

raj: agree on transform. also add a tiny metadata sync window (1.5s) before routing finalization for deploy-related events to reduce races. cheap and effective.

tina: quota question: if soft-suppress reduces weight, should billing/quotas reflect adjusted weight? customers expect cost savings.

ellis: yes — quota calc should use adjusted weight. hard-suppress counts zero but increments suppression_audit metrics for billing reconciliation.

simone: telemetry requests: metric notify_suppression_applied{mode,tenant,trigger}; log field fanout_estimate{orig,adjusted,reason}; and an audit event in the policy history.

raj: API sketch for simulate endpoint: POST /v1/notify/suppress/simulate {tenant,mode,duration,meta} -> {estimated_fanout,estimated_cost_delta,coverage_delta,trace_id}. same call with mutate=true applies it.

tina: UX: show estimated numbers and a short banner: "preview-only reduces pings but may skip escalation contacts. check runbook." link to runbook.

ellis: dev plan:
- P0: routing-transform + 1.5s metadata hold + suppression metric (1 sprint)
- P1: simulate endpoint + console modal w/ estimates (1 sprint)
- P2: quota/billing integration + audit trail (1 sprint)

simone: also add a debug endpoint to replay fanout decisions for a given incident id; include fanout_estimate log. helpful for postmortems.

deploy-bot: deploy f3a2b rollback started 2025-09-11T03:22:11Z -> canary failed, rollback begun

ava: ok. raj & simone pair on transform prototype. tina will wire the modal. ellis will own quota impacts. i'll write the gating checklist for staging rollout. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
